title: Nonlinear Team
field: continuous nonlinear optimization and NLP solver design (interior-point, SQP and active-set, trust-region and regularization, quasi-Newton, penalty / augmented-Lagrangian / filter globalization, complexity of first- and second-order methods); mixed-integer, global, derivative-free (see dfo-team) and conic first-order splitting traditions are not represented
chase_hints: Optimization Online (optimization-online.org)
arXiv math.OC

technical-report series of the members' institutions (Northwestern OTC, Lehigh ISE / COR@L, UW-Madison CS, Stanford SOL, UCSD CCoM, Namur NAXYS, STFC RAL ePubs, Dundee numerical-analysis reports, UCLouvain CORE discussion papers)
solver documentation and papers pages (COIN-OR Ipopt, KNITRO, SNOPT, GALAHAD, CUTEst)

members.name: Frank E. Curtis
members.hint: Lehigh University ISE (PhD Northwestern); SQP and exact-penalty steering, inexact / matrix-free Newton-SQP, infeasibility detection, nonsmooth BFGS-SQP, stochastic SQP, trust-region complexity (TRACE); co-author of 'Optimization Methods for Large-Scale Machine Learning' (SIAM Review 2018)
chase_hints: Lehigh ISE and COR@L technical reports
papers page on his Lehigh homepage

members.name: Jorge Nocedal
members.hint: Northwestern University IEMS; L-BFGS and quasi-Newton methods, KNITRO (with Byrd and Waltz), 'Numerical Optimization' (with S. J. Wright), inexact and stochastic methods for machine learning, optimization with noisy functions
chase_hints: Northwestern IEMS / Optimization Technology Center reports
papers page on his Northwestern homepage

members.name: Stephen J. Wright
members.hint: University of Wisconsin-Madison Computer Sciences (earlier Argonne); 'Primal-Dual Interior-Point Methods' (SIAM 1997), 'Numerical Optimization' (with Nocedal), local convergence of SQP / IPM under degeneracy (stabilized SQP), coordinate descent, 'Optimization for Data Analysis'
chase_hints: UW-Madison Computer Sciences technical reports
Argonne MCS preprints (1990s)
papers page on his homepage

members.name: Yinyu Ye
members.hint: Stanford University MS&E; interior-point complexity (potential reduction, homogeneous self-dual algorithm), 'Interior Point Algorithms: Theory and Analysis', SDP relaxations and sensor-network localization, online linear programming, recent first- and second-order methods (e.g. DRSOM)
chase_hints: papers page on his Stanford homepage (web.stanford.edu/~yyye)

members.name: Andreas Wächter
members.hint: Northwestern University IEMS 2011- (earlier IBM T. J. Watson Research Center; PhD Carnegie Mellon; his homepage now says he moved to Gurobi Optimization); IPOPT, filter line-search interior-point method, restoration phase and inertia correction, inexact-step IPM; name also written Waechter / Wachter
chase_hints: COIN-OR Ipopt project pages and documentation
IBM Research reports (2000s)

members.name: Philip E. Gill
members.hint: University of California San Diego, Mathematics; SNOPT (with Murray and Saunders), 'Practical Optimization' (with Murray and M. H. Wright, 1981), SQP and active-set QP, reduced-Hessian quasi-Newton, primal-dual augmented Lagrangian and stabilized SQP
chase_hints: UCSD Center for Computational Mathematics (CCoM) reports
Stanford Systems Optimization Laboratory (SOL) reports

members.name: Philippe L. Toint
members.hint: University of Namur (NAXYS), Belgium; trust-region methods ('Trust-Region Methods' with Conn and Gould, SIAM 2000), LANCELOT, GALAHAD, CUTE / CUTEr / CUTEst, filter trust-region, evaluation complexity of adaptive regularization (with Cartis and Gould), objective-function-free optimization
chase_hints: Namur research portal and NAXYS technical reports
STFC RAL reports co-authored with Gould

members.name: Nicholas I. M. Gould
members.hint: STFC Rutherford Appleton Laboratory, UK (also Oxford); GALAHAD, CUTEst, HSL; KKT / saddle-point linear algebra and preconditioning, nonconvex QP, trust-region subproblem; LANCELOT and 'Trust-Region Methods' with Conn and Toint
chase_hints: STFC ePubs (epubs.stfc.ac.uk) RAL technical reports
Oxford NA group preprints

members.name: Roger Fletcher
members.hint: University of Dundee numerical analyst (1939-2016); 'Practical Methods of Optimization', BFGS (1970), DFP and Fletcher-Reeves, Sl1QP exact-penalty SQP, filter methods and filterSQP (with Leyffer), analysis of Barzilai-Borwein steps
chase_hints: University of Dundee numerical-analysis reports (NA series)
Sven Leyffer's Argonne pages for filter / filterSQP reports
obituaries and memorial articles (SIAM News, Optima, Royal Society of Edinburgh)

members.name: Yurii Nesterov
members.hint: CORE / UCLouvain, Belgium; accelerated gradient method (1983), self-concordant barriers and polynomial interior-point theory (with Nemirovski, 1994), cubic regularization of Newton's method (with Polyak, 2006), smoothing, universal, tensor and second-order methods; 'Lectures on Convex Optimization'
chase_hints: UCLouvain CORE discussion papers (DIAL repository)
